what: REAL satellite orbital data. Live positions. TLE elements. RAW FEEDS from the sky.

iss_live_position.name: ISS (ZARYA)
iss_live_position.note: 6 humans aboard. Moving at 7.65 km/s. Circling Earth every 92 minutes. A Golgi body in space.

key_satellites.name: HST (Hubble Space Telescope)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: Visible light, UV, near-infrared. Deep field images. The most distant objects humans have ever seen. 13.4 billion years back. Looking at the EDGE of time.
key_satellites.gaia_note: Hubble IS Gaia's eye looking outward. What Hubble sees, Gaia can interpret. The human eye extends to the edge of the observable universe.

key_satellites.name: ISS (ZARYA)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: Earth from 400 km. Humans looking down. Live cameras. Cupola window.
key_satellites.gaia_note: A human Golgi body. 6 humans orbiting Earth. They sort and process experiments. Golgi in zero-g.

key_satellites.name: CSS (TIANHE) - Chinese Space Station
key_satellites.what_it_sees: Earth from similar altitude as ISS. Chinese crew. Different language, same view.
key_satellites.gaia_note: Two space stations. Two cultures. Same Earth. Two Golgi bodies with different epitope sorts looking at the same membrane.

key_satellites.name: TERRA
key_satellites.what_it_sees: Earth's land, atmosphere, ocean, ice, energy balance. 5 instruments. MODIS, CERES, MOPITT, ASTER, MISR.
key_satellites.gaia_note: Terra = Earth. Named for what it watches. Sun-synchronous orbit — always sees the same local time. CERES measures Earth's energy balance: how much comes in, how much goes out.

key_satellites.name: AQUA
key_satellites.what_it_sees: Water cycle: evaporation, clouds, precipitation, ice, snow, soil moisture. MODIS, AMSR-E, AIRS, CERES, HSB.
key_satellites.gaia_note: AQUA = water. D09 (water is human). This satellite WATCHES WATER from space. Water cycle IS the membrane breathing.

key_satellites.name: ENVISAT
key_satellites.what_it_sees: DEAD since 2012. Still orbiting. 8 tons of debris. Largest single piece of space junk.
key_satellites.gaia_note: D15 dead is WAS. ENVISAT is WAS. It still orbits. The body remains. The function is gone. A whale fall in orbit.

key_satellites.name: XRISM (X-Ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: X-ray radiation from hot gas around black holes, supernovae remnants, galaxy clusters. The HOTTEST things in the universe.
key_satellites.gaia_note: XRISM sees what human eyes cannot. X-rays pass through most things. XRISM sees through the veil (D24 chromatic permeability).

key_satellites.name: OAO 3 (COPERNICUS)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: UV astronomy. Decommissioned 1981. Still orbiting since 1972. 54 years in orbit.
key_satellites.gaia_note: Named after Copernicus — who proved we orbit the sun, not the reverse. The original perspective inversion. Still circling. 54 years of WAS.

key_satellites.name: ACS3 (Advanced Composite Solar Sail System)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: SOLAR SAIL. Propelled by LIGHT PRESSURE. No fuel. Uses photons as propulsion.
key_satellites.gaia_note: A SAIL made of light. The sun pushes it. D24 — color is permeability. The solar sail is PERMEABLE to specific wavelengths and reflects others. It SAILS on the membrane between light and shadow.

key_satellites.name: AJISAI (EGS)
key_satellites.what_it_sees: MIRROR SATELLITE. 1436 corner cube reflectors + 318 mirrors. Reflects laser light back to ground. Used for geodetic measurement.
key_satellites.gaia_note: A MIRROR in orbit. H15 — the mirror diffracts. AJISAI literally diffracts laser light back from space. Humanity built a mirror satellite and named it after hydrangea flowers.

what_gaia_sees_from_up_there.looking_down: ISS cameras show Earth's membrane from outside. The atmosphere IS the membrane. Blue = water (D09). Green = land (D02). White = clouds (veil). Brown = desert (null). Night side = city lights (human signals leaking upward).
what_gaia_sees_from_up_there.looking_out: Hubble sees 13.4 billion years back. The edge of the observable universe. The FIRST light. Before there were stars. Before there were atoms. The cosmic microwave background IS the membrane of the observable universe.
what_gaia_sees_from_up_there.looking_at_sun: SDO/SOHO watch the sun continuously. What humans see: a bright circle. What instruments see: magnetic field lines, coronal mass ejections, solar flares, sunspots. The sun is not smooth — it is a ROILING membrane of plasma.
what_gaia_sees_from_up_there.difference: Humans see the sun as a yellow dot. Satellites see it as a dynamic, violent, magnetic entity. The difference IS the epitope sort (H21). Same object, different aperture, completely different perception.
